subject.title: fix(gateway): OAuth-only xAI tools are missing from CLI-backend sessions

question: Should CLI-backend loopback tool resolution use only the session agent's auth store, with no inherited main-store OAuth profiles for non-main agents?
rationale: The implementation can be repaired mechanically, but the no-main-overlay behavior changes credential inheritance semantics and should be accepted explicitly as an auth/security boundary.

options.title: Use agent-local loopback auth
options.body: Fix the prepare/runtime mismatch and land the no-main-overlay shape so OAuth-backed loopback tools appear only from the session agent's own auth store.

options.title: Preserve main-overlay compatibility
options.body: Revise both prepare-time and runtime loopback resolution to keep inherited main OAuth profiles for non-main agents, accepting the broader credential scope.

options.title: Pause for another candidate
options.body: Defer this PR if maintainers prefer a different open implementation for the same linked issue with equivalent proof and boundary coverage.

recommendation.title: Use agent-local loopback auth
recommendation.body: Fix the prepare/runtime mismatch and land the no-main-overlay shape so OAuth-backed loopback tools appear only from the session agent's own auth store.

likelyOwner.reason: pgondhi987 is the strongest recent owner signal for the gateway tool-resolution and loopback runtime seam that needs this boundary choice.
